hypotheses: A correction can look useful against an inferior baseline. Compare every correction to a fixed finite simple-model pool on identical keys, and choose bases by completed past errors.
Copying the own 2023 seasonal profile may help aggregate expenses but hinder a rapidly changing marketplace category. Evaluate fixed shrinkage values without test-window selection.
The incremental information in matched peers may be smaller than the total benefit of own-plus-peer features. Compare peer versus own and versus pre-stratified shuffled peer feature histories.

baseline_selection.origins: 2024-01 onward, with u+h<=current origin; compute each candidate at u with observations <=u
baseline_selection.mask: All1539 supported municipalities, same complete comparison mask
baseline_selection.past_pick: Select minimum pooled mean absolute error within category and current horizon; deterministic ties in declared pool order
baseline_selection.past_mix: Arithmetic mean of the two models with lowest completed pooled mean absolute errors; stable ties in pool order
baseline_selection.cold_start: Both selectors exactly Profile SES; do not label them trained
baseline_selection.unsupported_municipalities: Receive the supported-cohort global selector but no feature correction; excluded from headline supported comparisons
baseline_selection.historical_selected_labels: Correction residuals for adaptive bases use the baseline that would have been selected at each historical u, never retroactive current selection
baseline_selection.h6: No completed direct h6 label in this evaluation; selectors and direct corrections are cold, exact Profile SES. One-step corrections transferred to h6 are labelled transfers.

correction.features: Existing frozen own5 and own5+peer5 from consumption_restructuring; no redefinition
correction.label: log(actual[u+k]/base_forecast[u,u+k]), k=1 for one_step, k=current horizon for direct, u+k<=origin
correction.fit: Training-only mean and population std; zero intercept; ridge0.1; clip predicted log correction to[-0.1,0.1]
correction.unsupported: Exactly their uncorrected base; no filling missing peer features

seasonal_profile_diagnostic.formula: Existing Profile SES in log own/category-median ratios with own2023 season multiplied by fixed shrinkage; all other formula/alpha grid/factor unchanged
seasonal_profile_diagnostic.use: Report all four; no selection by test outcomes; 0.7 must reproduce Profile SES exactly; diagnostic candidates not added to adaptive selection pool

peer_alignment_control.strata: Supported municipalities only, municipal type x floor(log2(population2023)); sorted strata and IDs
peer_alignment_control.permutation: Within each stratum, uniformly permute the entire12month x5 peer-extra feature history; own5 unchanged; one deterministic mapping per replicate across categories/horizons/origins
peer_alignment_control.singleton: Retain unchanged; report singleton and self-mapping counts
peer_alignment_control.fit: Retrain on shuffled histories, training-only standardization and completed labels, exactly same ridge and clip
peer_alignment_control.reporting: Report every replicate MAE, matched-peer versus own gains and empirical control ranks; no permutation p-value or real FDR claim
peer_alignment_control.limits: Feature alignment placebo, not a newly matched peer network; exchangeability not established; self mappings reduce perturbation

uncertainty.metric: MAE in source units; paired gains on exactly same supported rows
uncertainty.intervals: 10000 paired target-month block bootstrap; region-block sensitivity separately; seed20261007
uncertainty.limits: Six target months, overlapping horizons, many exploratory comparisons; intervals not confirmatory multiplicity-adjusted evidence

verification: Future mutation of all categories after every evaluation origin must leave candidates, choices, fit metadata and predictions unchanged
Exact stored actual/Profile SES/category seasonal/Growth3 agreement on old204768 keys
Independent scalar baseline checks and independent augmented least-squares correction checks
Every selector/correction label target <= origin; directh6 cold; unsupported feature outputs exactly base

Save every positive and negative category/model result, masks, fit and selection trace, control mappings and SHA
limits: All2024 target data already viewed; newly frozen specification is post hoc exploratory
Retrospective complete panel and current dictionary; historical publication/vintage not verified
Monthly index cutoffs are idealized information boundaries, not verified historical publication dates
